name: marketing_skills_for_ai_agents
description: Provides marketing skillsets for Claude Code and AI agents, including CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization), copywriting, SEO (Search Engine Optimization), analytics, and growth engineering to support AI-driven marketing strategies.

inputs.name: marketing_goal
inputs.description: The primary marketing objective or target to optimize, such as increasing conversions, improving SEO ranking, or enhancing copy effectiveness.

inputs.name: content_data
inputs.description: Marketing content or copy that needs optimization or generation.

inputs.name: analytics_data
inputs.description: Data collected from marketing campaigns or websites to analyze performance and guide growth strategies.

inputs.name: seo_keywords
inputs.description: List of keywords relevant for SEO optimization.

outputs.name: optimized_copy
outputs.description: Marketing copy improved for engagement, conversions, or SEO effectiveness.

outputs.name: seo_report
outputs.description: Analysis and recommendations based on SEO keyword performance.

outputs.name: growth_strategy
outputs.description: Suggested approaches and tactics for growth engineering based on analytics.

outputs.name: conversion_insights
outputs.description: Insights derived from CRO analytics to enhance marketing funnels.

steps: Input relevant marketing content, keywords, or analytics data.
Analyze data to assess current marketing performance.
Generate or optimize marketing copy using AI techniques.
Apply SEO best practices and provide keyword recommendations.
Derive insights to inform growth engineering tactics.
Iterate and refine marketing elements based on feedback and testing results.
use_cases: Enhancing website and landing page conversion rates.
Generating compelling marketing copy for campaigns.
Optimizing content for search engine rankings.
Analyzing campaign analytics to identify growth opportunities.
Developing data-driven growth strategies for startups and businesses.

prompt_templates.name: copywriting_optimization
prompt_templates.template: Improve the following marketing copy for better conversion and clarity: {content_data}

prompt_templates.name: seo_keyword_analysis
prompt_templates.template: Analyze and suggest improvements for SEO using the keywords: {seo_keywords}

prompt_templates.name: growth_strategy_recommendation
prompt_templates.template: Based on the following analytics data, suggest a growth strategy: {analytics_data}

prompt_templates.name: conversion_rate_insights
prompt_templates.template: Provide insights and recommendations to improve conversion rates for the marketing goal: {marketing_goal}
